Job Description Our team develops new techniques and processes to better meet the needs of our Audio and TV clients to measure audiences, working at the intersection of Data Science, Technology, Product Delivery and Operations. Responsibilities Research, design, develop, implement and test econometric, statistical, optimization and machine learning models. Gain a deep understanding of the PPM (Portable People Meter) sampling methodology and become an expert in Audience Measurement, with a focus on panel management strategies. Query data from large relational databases for various analyses and/or requests. Utilize tools such as Python, Tableau, R etc. to perform complex data analysis and visualizations. Oversee, maintain and evolve multiple data algorithms for managing the PPM Sample Methodology in a time-critical production environment. Maintain and update documented departmental procedures, checklists and metrics comprehensively and on a timely basis. Serve on various interdepartmental teams seeking to propose, evaluate and implement new initiatives, and work on other critical projects. This includes support with writing requirements, developing new software and testing. Respond to various internal and external client requests, providing data driven solutions to the problems presented. Incorporate quality checks to proactively detect and correct for errors throughout production processing and analysis. Ensure product quality, stability, and scalability by facilitating code reviews and driving best practices like modular code, unit tests, and incorporating CI/CD workflows. Qualifications Bachelor’s Degree or higher in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Data Science, Data Engineering or a related field. 3+ years of professional work experience in Statistics, Data Science, and/or related disciplines, with focus on delivering analytical software solutions in a production environment. 3+ years of experience with the following: Manipulating, analyzing and interpreting complex data sources to tell a story from data through analyses Programming in Python, PySpark and SQL for data pipeline development used to support analytics Data visualization with Tableau and/or similar tools Experience working in cloud-based environments such as AWS DevOps tools, code management and CI/CD workflows using Gitlab or similar tools Project management including ability to prioritize multiple assignments Well-organized, clear communication, and an ability to handle multiple competing priorities in a fast-paced environment. Embraces innovation with a readiness to explore new solutions and a commitment to rapid iteration based on customer feedback. Demonstrates strategic thinking, understanding the broader impact of data insights on product and business objectives. Exceptional problem solving skills. Abilities to solve problems independently and within a cross-functional team to resolve issues in the projects. Nice to have: Working Knowledge of statistical tests and procedures such as ANOVA, Chi-squared, Correlation, Regression, and Student t-test. Expertise in querying large datasets with SQL and of working with Oracle/Netezza/Data Warehouse and Data Lake data structures. Critical thinking skills to evaluate results in order to make timely decisions. Experience with machine learning technology, such as: big data stack, Java, Python, R, Scala and visualization techniques, including Dash, Tableau and Angular. What Success Looks Like In your first 6–12 months, success means: You establish a strong mobile foundation and ship a production‑quality iOS and Android application. You independently own and deliver key mobile components or features end‑to‑end. You proactively identify risks, trade‑offs, and improvement opportunities, addressing them early. Clients trust your judgment and value your contributions. Other engineers rely on you for guidance, clarity, and technical leadership as the mobile capability grows. What You Should Have 6–8+ years of experience designing and building production software. Strong commercial experience building production mobile applications with React Native. Experience shipping and operating apps on both iOS and Android. Strong proficiency in modern JavaScript and TypeScript. Solid understanding of mobile application architecture, performance, and reliability. Experience consuming GraphQL APIs in production and collaborating on schema evolution. Solid understanding of SDLC practices, CI/CD, automated testing with tools such as Detox or Maestro, and code quality. Excellent written and spoken English communication skills (C1+ is highly preferred) Bonus Points Experience defining architecture and patterns for greenfield products. Backend & cloud engineering exposure (.NET & Azure) to support cross‑team collaboration. Experience with cloud platforms and data‑intensive systems. Background in financial services, consulting, or similarly complex domains. Why Lab49? At Lab49, you'll work on complex, meaningful problems with talented engineers, designers, and consultants. You'll gain broad exposure to technologies, business domains, and client environments as you grow your career. We value curiosity, judgment, and ownership. If you care about quality, enjoy helping others succeed, and want your work to have real impact, Lab49 is a place where you can thrive. Our Hybrid Work Model This role is based in Mexico City with a hybrid work model. Team members typically work in person one day per week, and more when needed, collaborating closely with teammates in Mexico and the US. We believe this balance supports both flexibility and the collaboration needed to deliver excellent outcomes.

Title: Senior Data Scientist, Analytics
Description: Company Description Etsy is the global marketplace for unique and creative goods. This person will partner with the Growth group, whose focus is supporting teams working to support long-term buyer LTV through strategic offers and other tactics to drive retention and frequency. This role requires your presence in Etsy’s Mexico City Office once or twice per week depending on your proximity to the office. Candidates living within commutable distance of Etsy’s Mexico City Office Hub may be the first to be considered. Learn more details about our work modes and workplace safety policies here. What’s this team like at Etsy? Data scientists at Etsy use rigorous methods to generate insights that inform product, marketing, engineering, and business decisions across the company. We collaborate with partner teams through all stages of development: actively uncovering opportunity areas, crafting experiments to test hypotheses, analyzing the impact of our efforts, and highlighting takeaways. Learning new skills and techniques is not only a requirement but a perk of the job! We are always looking for opportunities to grow. Our mission is to guide our partner teams with data and insights and tell the story of how we attract and retain our users — to teams, to senior management, and to the community. What does the day-to-day look like? Partner with the Growth group, whose focus is supporting teams working to support long-term buyer LTV through strategic offers and other tactics to drive retention and frequency. Play a meaningful role in deciding how we can best engage and grow Etsy users through analysis of behavioral and transactional data. Design and analyze rigorous experiments, help teams set great hypotheses, and deliver robust analysis of experiment results. Transform raw data into meaningful and impactful analysis characterized by strong data governance, technique transparency, and clear documentation. Raise the skill level of the entire analytics team through the creation of outstanding work, mentorship, and the introduction of better practices, processes, and tools. Of course, this is just a sample of the kinds of work this role will require! You should assume that your role will encompass other tasks, too, and that your job duties and responsibilities may change from time to time at Etsy's discretion, or otherwise applicable with local law. Qualities that will help you thrive in this role are: 4+ years experience as a data scientist or data analyst in which you have independently extracted meaning from big data sets with little engineering support. Mastery of SQL and proficiency in R/Python. Passionate to try new approaches to advance your technical skills. Bonus points for experience with Spark and Looker, Tableau, or other data visualization software. Deep understanding of experimentation theory and practice. Specialize in sophisticated analyses and regularly use statistical methods in your work. Distill highly complex problems into narratives that are concise, actionable, and memorable, and express your recommendations with both conviction and finesse. Guided product teams to identify high-impact opportunities, set meaningful goals against key outcomes, and driven decisions. Passionate about reproducible work and have picked up tools to this end. Acted as a mentor, guiding others to make their own work better and more efficient. Additional Information What's Next If you're interested in joining the team at Etsy, please share your resume with us and feel free to include a cover letter if you'd like. As we hope you've seen already, Etsy is a place that values individuality and variety. We don't want you to be like everyone else -- we want you to be like you! So tell us what you're all about. Our Promise At Etsy, we believe that a diverse, equitable and inclusive workplace furthers relevance, resilience, and longevity. We encourage people from all backgrounds, ages, abilities, and experiences to apply. Etsy is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Collaborate with product software engineers to deliver ML models that enhance recommendations, personalization, and generative AI features. Strong cloud expertise (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and experience with deployment platforms (ECS, EKS, Lambda). Proven ability to optimize system performance and make informed trade-offs in ML model and system design. Experience leading technical projects and mentoring engineers. Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent professional experience. Nice to Have Experience with embedding-based retrieval, large language models, advanced recommendation or ranking systems. Experience building or leading development of feature stores, model serving & monitoring platforms, and experimentation systems. Expertise in experimentation design, causal inference, or ML evaluation methodologies. Contributions to open-source ML/AI tooling or infrastructure. Title: SWAT Owner (Payments)
Description: COMPANY DESCRIPTION EFEX (www.efex.com) is a business class global treasury platform for medium sized businesses doing international trade between US and Mexico. With EFEX's technology you can offer your clients: ● Multi-currency Business Accounts in USD, MXN, EUR, GBP, CAD and more ● Collection in 31 local currencies ● International payments in 140 countries ● Bulk payments with Excel files in 3 clicks, at no cost ● FX operations 24/7 ● Dual compliance: FDIC-insured funds via Community Federal Savings Bank + FinCEN registration in the US; CNBV-regulated in Mexico EFEX is disrupting payments for international trade companies within the US-Mexico trade corridor: a $800 Bn fast-growing and fragmented market, traditionally controlled by legacy players with cumbersome processes and outdated solutions. Our platform is trusted by companies transacting over $1 billion annually. Our high performance team comes from Stanford, Harvard, and the top fintechs in the world. ABOUT THE ROLE As a SWAT Owner for Payments, you will own the entire payments domain at EFEX end-to-end: strategy, technical architecture, hands-on delivery, and measurable business outcomes. But this is not a traditional product or engineering leadership role. We believe we are at an inflection point in software development. AI-powered tools — from code generation and automated testing to AI-assisted debugging, code review, and architecture design — are fundamentally changing what a small, focused engineering team can accomplish. We are looking for a SWAT Owner who doesn't just "use AI" but who operates with an AI-first mindset across every phase of the product lifecycle — from discovery and design through implementation and post-launch measurement — treating AI as a core multiplier of speed, quality, and business impact. You will be fully accountable for the success of EFEX's payments product area, measured by clear business KPIs: cash to payment, revenue, margin, conversion, transaction reliability, latency, cost, and compliance. You will translate company-level strategy into a payments roadmap, make hard prioritization trade-offs, and design the technical architecture. When every engineer on the team is operating at 5–10x the speed of a traditional developer, you are the person who ensures that velocity is aimed at the outcomes that matter most — not just feature delivery, but measurable business results. This is a hands-on, outcome-driven role that blends product leadership with technical architecture ownership and daily execution. We need someone who can define product requirements, architect payment systems, write production code, mentor engineers, and track business KPIs post-launch — all while continuously using AI to automate and accelerate every step of the development process. QUALIFICATIONS 5+ years owning a product area or domain end-to-end and 2+ years of software engineering experience — including responsibility for both technical delivery and business outcomes. Deep experience in payments, fintech, or banking — with a strong understanding of payment processing, settlement, reconciliation, fraud prevention, and the regulatory landscape. Demonstrated, hands-on experience using AI development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or similar) in production workflows. You should be able to articulate exactly how AI tools changed your delivery speed, code quality, or team output, with concrete examples. Experience building internal AI/LLM-powered tools or integrating AI into product features and development workflows, with a track record of using AI to automate and increase efficiency across the end-to-end development process.} Strong product thinking — experience defining product requirement documents, setting success metrics, making explicit prioritization trade-offs, and continuously balancing time-to-market, technical quality, scalability, and business impact. Track record of identifying opportunities to improve unit economics, operational efficiency, and customer experience through technology decisions. Deep understanding of API design, microservices architecture, event-driven architecture, and system integration patterns — particularly for payment gateway integrations, third-party provider orchestration, and multi-provider failover strategies. Strong expertise in cloud security for fintech — including secure architecture design, encryption at rest and in transit, secrets management, PCI-DSS compliance, and zero-trust security models appropriate for handling sensitive financial data and transactions. Experience mentoring engineers on an AI-first and customer-first mindset, raising technical standards, and building a culture of ownership — leading by example through hands-on development, not just coordination. Ability to proactively identify technical risks, debt, and bottlenecks, and drive refactors and ong-term architectural improvements while maintaining delivery momentum. Description: About Us SimplePractice is headquartered in Los Angeles, California, but we have team members who work and live across the United States, Dominican Republic, Mexico City, and Ukraine. Title: Lead Product Analyst - Premium
Description: Scribd, Inc. is on a mission to advance human understanding. Our four products — Scribd®, Slideshare®, Everand™, and Fable — help billions of people across the globe move beyond access and into insight, application, and expertise. Culture at Scribd, Inc. We support a culture where our employees can be real and be bold; where we debate and commit as we embrace plot twists; and where every employee is empowered to take action as we prioritize the customer. We believe the best work happens when individual flexibility is balanced with meaningful community connection. Scribd Flex empowers employees to choose the workstyle and location that support their best performance, while committing to intentional in-person moments that strengthen collaboration and culture. Occasional in-person attendance is required for all Scribd, Inc. employees, regardless of location. So what are we looking for in new team members? At Scribd, Inc., we hire for “GRIT.” Traditionally defined as the intersection of passion and perseverance toward long-term goals, GRIT reflects the mindset we expect from every employee. For us, it also serves as a practical framework for how we work: setting and achieving Goals, delivering Results within your role, contributing Innovative ideas and solutions, and strengthening the broader Team through collaboration and attitude. This posting reflects an approved, open position within the organization. About The Team The mission of the Data & Analytics team is to ensure the entire company understands business performance and trends, and to empower all business teams to make good decisions with data. The Growth organization focuses on driving sustainable subscriber and user growth across Scribd’s ecosystem, including Scribd, Everand, Slideshare, and Fable. We work to improve how users discover, sign up for, activate, and retain value across our products. Our work spans acquisition, activation, retention, and monetization, with a deep emphasis on data quality, measurement, and experimentation. About The Role The Lead Product Analyst, Premium will play a critical role in shaping how we understand, measure, and optimize the end-to-end product experience across Scribd’s Premium portfolio, including the Everand and Fable apps. You are a strategic, technically strong analytics leader who partners deeply with Product Managers to influence product direction, experimentation strategy, and measurement frameworks. You bring a strong point of view on experimentation, instrumentation, and metric design, and understand how to connect user behavior to business outcomes in subscription-based products. You are equally comfortable defining analytics foundations (event standards, tracking taxonomies, data quality) and synthesizing insights into clear narratives that guide decision-making. You act as a trusted thought partner to PMs, helping teams stay aligned on what success looks like and how progress is measured across both apps. You Will Own end-to-end product analytics for the Premium experience across Everand and Fable, spanning activation, engagement, monetization, retention, and cancellation. Serve as a strategic thought partner to PMs, influencing product strategy through experimentation insights, funnel analysis, and feature-level measurement. Design and lead end-to-end experimentation frameworks for Premium initiatives, including hypothesis generation, test design, metric definition, analysis, and executive-ready readouts. Partner with Product and Data Science to establish experimentation best practices, success criteria, and statistical rigor, including the use of external experimentation platforms (e.g., Statsig or similar). Define and maintain standardized instrumentation and event taxonomy frameworks across Premium surfaces, partnering closely with Engineering to ensure consistent, high-quality data collection. Measure and evaluate the performance of new feature launches through clear input and output metrics, post-launch analysis, and iteration recommendations. Build and maintain scalable dashboards and reporting frameworks in Looker and Databricks to track Premium health, product KPIs, and weekly business metrics. Conduct deep-dive funnel, cohort, and behavioral analyses to identify friction points and opportunities across both apps. Track progress against key product goals, ensuring alignment between inputs (feature adoption, engagement signals) and outputs (retention, revenue, LTV). Present insights regularly in metrics forums and product reviews, helping teams maintain a shared, end-to-end view of Premium performance. Ensure data quality, governance, and visibility across tracking systems, improving confidence in decision-making. Mentor analysts and help establish best practices for product analytics, experimentation, and measurement standards across the Premium pillar. You Have 3+ years of experience in product analytics, ideally within a consumer-facing or subscription-based product environment. Advanced proficiency in SQL and Python or R for data analysis, experimentation support, and insight generation. Strong experience with experimentation design and analysis, including hands-on use of external experimentation platforms (e.g., Statsig or similar tools). Deep experience building and maintaining dashboards in BI tools such as Looker, including working with LookML and defining trusted metrics. Experience working with modern data warehouses such as Databricks, including collaborating with Data Engineering on modeling, performance, and reliability. Proven experience defining event schemas, instrumentation standards, and tracking taxonomies in partnership with Engineering teams. Strong understanding of funnel analysis, feature measurement, cohort analysis, and post-launch evaluation. Ability to synthesize complex analyses into clear, actionable insights and communicate them effectively to PMs, engineers, and leadership. Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field such as Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or Economics (Master’s degree a plus). Why This Role Matters This is a high-impact role with broad visibility and ownership across Scribd’s Premium products. You’ll help define how success is measured, how experiments are run, and how insights drive decisions across Everand and Fable. Your work will shape the analytics foundations, metrics, and narratives that guide Premium product strategy end to end.
